class.name: GiantBody
class.brief_description: The root node of a giant: sets her height in metres and how slowly she moves at that size.
class.description: Put the giant's model under a [GiantBody]. The node's origin must sit on the ground between the feet, so growing scales the giant up from the ground. Setting [member height] sets the node's scale; do not scale the node yourself. [b]Time feel:[/b] real physics makes a body that is [code]s[/code] times bigger move [code]sqrt(s)[/code] times slower. [member time_feel] picks how much of that slowdown to keep: [code]0[/code] moves like a human at every size, [code]1[/code] is fully realistic, and the default [code]0.5[/code] sits in between. The [member animation_mixer] and every [GiantJiggle3D] under the giant follow this tempo. [b]Texture detail:[/b] every [GeometryInstance3D] under the giant receives the instance shader parameter [code]giant_scale[/code], so shaders can add finer detail as she grows. See [code]giant/README.md[/code].

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances growth and the [member animation_mixer] by [param delta] seconds of real time. Called automatically every frame while the game runs.

method.name: get_scale_factor
method.description: Returns how many times bigger the giant is than her model: [member height] divided by [member rest_height].

method.name: get_time_scale
method.description: Returns how fast the giant moves compared with human size, from [code]1.0[/code] (full speed) down. Animation and jiggle play at this speed.

method.name: grow_to
method.description: Smoothly changes [member height] to [param height] over [param duration] seconds. Growth is steady in log space, so 2 m to 20 m takes as long as 20 m to 200 m. Emits [signal growth_finished] at the end.

method.name: is_growing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a [method grow_to] is in progress.

method.name: stop_growing
method.description: Stops a growth started by [method grow_to] at the current height.

members.member: The [AnimationPlayer] or [AnimationTree] that animates the giant. While the game runs, the giant drives it at [method get_time_scale] speed.
The giant's height in metres. Changing it scales the node about its origin.
The height in metres of the giant's model at scale 1.
How much slower the giant moves as she grows: [code]0[/code] never slows down, [code]1[/code] follows real physics, values in between blend the two.

signal.name: growth_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a [method grow_to] reaches its target height.
